{{Quote|A starship crashed in a desert canyon. Use the Force. Find it....|[[Orgus Din]]'s Force ghost|<ref name="TOR:GbtF" />}}
In [[3642 BBY]], near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Hero of Tython]] and a companion '''fought''' a group of [[Harrower assassin]]s sent to kill the [[Jomar Chul's ship|crashed]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jomar Chul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Chul, who had been scouting the [[Dromund system]], had been shot down over Tatooine and pursued by the Harrowers, which were [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] servants of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref name="TOR:GbtF" />
